title: A warm transition finds a fair measure

captions.physics: Ending an exhausted form of help
captions.energy: Sharing a simple and friendly presence

meaning: Your open warmth can preserve a calm measure when ending unnecessary help leaves room for both people’s different needs.
text: Care can become lighter without losing warmth. In the physical position of Anahata, Death expresses involvement through ending an exhausted form of help and moving towards another. The Sun in energy brings a wish to share a simple, friendly presence and meet openly. Temperance in emotions offers accord between different needs and a suitable measure. Tenderness may come from an ending requiring neither cold refusal nor endless repetition of the former arrangement. Help remains available while each keeps room for an individual pace, a separate activity and an actual response to a new offer.

For example, you end the rule of one person always waiting after the other’s long rehearsal. Instead, you choose a short meeting later when both are genuinely free. **A former service can end for more manageable involvement.** Time remains for personal tasks and a quiet evening together. Warmth requires neither identical commitments nor making a freed hour debt to the former waiting person.

A wish to make change pleasant can conceal one person’s inconvenience. The measure you found looks agreed only outwardly. Alternatively, lightness requires immediately stopping missing familiar journeys together. Care stays in an actual response and permission to revise a solution. Relief and regret can be acknowledged while the unnecessary ends and attention remains, without making identical feelings compulsory for a new form of closeness.
